archetypes.name: timeout-semantics
archetypes.rationale: The change keeps distinct zero-handling semantics across sibling timeout knobs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the timeout default bump for semantic drift. Verify LARCH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS still treats zero as invalid while LARCH_EXTERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT keeps zero as an opt-out, and check that docs and regression tests align with those distinct behaviors. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
